results.name: Humano Osmar
Bronze Age pottery OL3K13B5S3
results.description:
Orenburg region, Sol-Iletsky district. Necropolis Obilkin meadow-3. Grave Hill No.13. Burial No.5. Chronology: Bronze Age; end of the 17th – 16th centuries BC. Vetlyansky type of archaeological sites, including signs of the Abashevo culture, Sintashta culture, early Srubnaya culture and Alakul culture.


Оренбургская область, Соль-Илецкий район. Могильник Обилькин луг-3. Курган №13. Погребение №5. Сосуд №3. Хронология: бронзовый век; конец XVII – XVI вв. до н.э. Ветлянский тип археологических памятников, включающий признаки абашевской культуры, синташтинской культуры, ранней срубной культуры и алакульской культуры.


Region Orenburg, Bezirk Sol-Iletsky. Nekropole Obilkin Wiese-3. Grabhügel Nr. 13. Beerdigung Nr.5. Chronologie: Bronzezeit; Ende des 17.–16. Jahrhunderts v. Chr. Archäologische Stätten vom Typ Vetlyansky, darunter Zeichen der Abashevo-Kultur, der Sintashta-Kultur, der frühen Srubnaya-Kultur und der Alakul-Kultur.

results.name: Polychrome bowl with Standard Primary Sequence
results.description:
Polychrome bowl (red and black on light orange) with convex walls and base. Above and below the rim is a horizontal black band followed by a horizontal red line. On the upper-middle portion of the wall, there is an inscription identified as a dedicatory formula or Standard Primary Sequence, with glyphs outlined in black.
 IDAEH Cultural Property No. 1.2.159.0016
www.fundacionrutamaya.org

Special thanks to the staff of La Ruta Maya Foundation for their hard work on this project.

3D model made in RealityScan; Total # of images: 287
